scope: Fresh-context independent citation audit of the 25 included references and their uses in docs/LITERATURE_SYNTHESIS_V2.md; not a new survey or experimental audit.
time_basis: Actual clock tool readings bound the online verification period; file reading began before the first recorded clock. Do not interpret wall-clock interval as student labor.
independence: Read project continuity and prior evidence as discovery clues; no prior VERIFIED label was accepted as proof. Queried full titles/distinctive titles plus authors and inspected primary paper/author/official pages via web tool. No Claude model was called.
verdict_interpretation: VERIFIED is limited to the statements used in the survey. For citations 5 and 7, full-text access is explicitly downgraded; specific official indexed method passages support the used summary, so these are not metadata-only PAYWALL claims.
excluded_from_scope: Independent confirmation of all 29 pool records and excluded papers
Reconstructing the previous researchers' individual query timestamps
Reproducing any literature experiment or video generation
Recomputing S6 metrics or validating 3453 checks
Exhaustive novelty proof or review of every paragraph in all 25 source papers
Execution or compatibility testing of public repositories
